gamma.input: Semantic R/G/B 257 mathematical points per channel, or 256 proposed 10-bit base/signed10 delta words per channel.
gamma.output: Explicit little-endian 256 words per channel, 12-bit base and signed12 delta.
gamma.validation: Exact sizes and endpoints, full-channel validation before output mutation, reserved-bit/continuity/range/alias rejection; rejects unrepresentable scaled slopes rather than clamping.
gamma.scope: Structural consistency and data conversion only. Private retained table continuity does not independently prove hardware semantics, channel selectors, calibrated curves or image quality.
